releaseNotes:
1. Offline Order Queue & Cloud Sync Reliability: Failed/offline checkouts queue safely into IndexedDB and auto-flush on reconnect; order item sync validates per-item cloud confirmation before marking synced.
2. Per-Item GST & Loyalty Split Receipt Math: Item tax rates and loyalty redemption splits match printed totals accurately.
3. Analytics & Store Manager Integrity: Fixed tender breakdowns (tenderType), local IST date alignment, GRN product stock updates, outlet profile persistence, and removed synthetic fallback figures.
4. Security, Hardware & AI Input Fixes: Hardened scale COM port/printer/update/auth checks, fixed AI Camera stream loop & AI Voice speech endpoint/hotkey F9 collision, and added graceful COM disconnect on shutdown.
